svg.title: Five flight motor neurons as dots on clock faces: uncoupled they drift independently, with flies' measured coupling they spread round the cycle, with spikelets they bunch; and the splayness of every condition run
svg.text: The flight motor neurons' splay state, from flies' measured coupling
Flies' five DLM motor neurons fire at one rate but avoid firing together (Hürkey et al. 2023). Joined by conductances at flies'
measured strengths, five of the model's units spread round the cycle the same way; the spikes' spikelets, without flies' long AHP, bunch them.
Splayness, every condition run (300 s × 8 runs, medians)
